cohort_selection: All seven already released external development cases; no replacement or case selection from outcomes.
scope: Conservative operational atomic-reference qualification of selected modeled atoms in existing development systems. These are model-phased experimental references; no independent confirmatory, unseen-family, biological specificity, binding-energy or complete-assembly certification.

required_policy.frozen_before: This auditor inspected any atomic density maps or docking/pocket outcomes; no docking outcomes are read in this audit.
required_policy.selected_copies: Exactly the existing released ligand copies identified in site_reference_ledger.json; no alternative crystal-copy substitution.

required_per_scored_residue.density_map_type: wwPDB validation weighted coefficients transformed to complete unit-cell Fourier maps; mean-subtracted and normalized by full-cell standard deviation

required_policy.full_ligand: All released heavy atoms and all intended carbohydrate residues present, exact coordinate/atom-name correspondence, chemically consistent CCD/link graph and stereochemistry, every residue passes.
required_policy.modeled_core: Largest covalently connected component of whole qualifying modeled sugar residues; at least one complete sugar ring; tie-break by heavy-atom count, then ascending prepared residue-number tuple. All modeled atoms of each retained residue are scored. Never delete individual atoms to obtain a pass. Missing external substituents and original full graph are disclosed.
required_policy.geometry: Chirality flags and absolute bond/angle Z>=5 block a residue. Lower-Z and torsion/clash flags are retained and inspected; torsion alone is not rejected because binding can stabilize rare conformers. Unresolved linkage stereochemistry or CCD/coordinate disagreement blocks affected residues.
required_policy.assembly: Missing biological subunits are disclosed; absence blocks atomic qualification if omitted atoms contact the scored ligand within 4 A or supply required recognition cofactor. No biological-assembly-completeness or independent-fold claim.
required_policy.map_limit: Maps are model-phased validation reconstructions, not independent omit maps. Passing is an operational experimental-reference gate, not proof of a unique ligand conformation or coordinate accuracy.
required_policy.unknown_evidence: Unknown required evidence is not a pass; all seven remain in the denominator with explicit rejection/inconclusive reason.
required_policy.use: Source qualification only, development references; native positions, residue identities and this audit may not influence prediction search or ranking.

score_map_rule: Use exactly scored_atom_map. Same full released parent ligand graph is preserved; core means a partial coordinate endpoint, not a truncated or chemically repaired ligand. Excluded atoms must never be silently scored as atomic truth.
